mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the small and large vessels was most worthwhile because it showed the complete return route and why it prevents fluid buildup.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the larger vessels to the vein was clear, but it was the only combination offered, so the choice felt less engaging.

surprise.text: I didn't expect the return route to enter a neck vein; the compression and one-way valves also helped explain how fluid moves along it.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless: the two initial projects had clear roles, though later choices were automatic in practice because only one combination was offered.

continue.text: I'd probably continue for another chapter: the connected route made an unfamiliar body system understandable, though I'd hope for more meaningful choices.
